story.iWant: placement status automatically synced to TrespassTracker records
story.soThat: the is_daep flag and daep_expiration_date are always current across both modules

tasks.task: Create syncTrespassTrackerExpiration(schoolId) in app/actions/daep/placements.ts - Query daep_placements for status IN ('pending', 'active', 'transition') - If no active: set is_daep=false, daep_expiration_date=null - If active: set is_daep=true, find MAX(expected_end_date) - Update trespass_records with synced values

Create batchSyncTrespassTracker() for admin-triggered bulk sync - Get all unique school_id from daep_placements - Loop through each calling syncTrespassTrackerExpiration() - Continue-on-error, collect error array - Log to audit trail: system.batch_sync event

Integrate sync into existing placement actions: - createPlacement() after insert - updatePlacement() when expected_end_date changes - transitionPlacement() on complete/cancelled - recalculatePlacementDays() after recalc - markNoShow() and earlyTermination() (Story 2-12)

acceptanceCriteria.ac: Placement creation syncs to trespass_records (is_daep = true after create)
Expected end date syncs to daep_expiration_date (Date matches expected_end_date)
Multiple placements use farthest date (MAX(expected_end_date) used)
Completion clears flag if no other placements (is_daep = false when all complete)
Manual sync action available (Admin can trigger batch sync)
Sync logged to audit trail (Audit entries created for batch sync)
